items.description: New Mexico (6-1) at San Jose State (4-4), Oct. 31 at 4 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Luke Duncan and Marshaun Brown each have 2 total TDs, Nevada beats San Jose State 28-13
items.description: — Luke Duncan threw two touchdown passes, Marshaun Brown added a TD reception and a 32-yard scoring pass to Herschel Turner Jr., and Nevada beat San Jose State 28-13 on Saturday.

items.headline: Nevada takes on San Jose State in MWC play
items.description: San Jose State (4-3) at Nevada (2-4), Oct. 24 at 5 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Teu's 2 TDs help San Jose State subdue UTEP in 24-11 win
items.description: — Viliami Teu ran for 156 yards and two touchdowns and San Jose State beat UTEP 24-11 on Saturday night.
